[CR CR0064r2 for 38.463] Reason for change: The conuter check procedure was introduced in CP-UP slit case. However, in TS38.463, the PDCP UL Count IE and PDCP DL Count IE contained in GNB-CU-UP COUNTER CHECK REQUEST is not correct. It was agreed and specified in TS38.331 that: CounterCheck message is used by the network to indicate the current COUNT MSB values associated to each DRB and to request the UE to compare these to its COUNT MSB values and to report the comparison results to the network The COUNT MSB values includes countMSB-Downlink and countMSB-Uplink, which indicates the value of 25 MSBs from RX_NEXT – 1 and 25 MSBs from TX_NEXT – 1, respectively.
